supported_claims: A queued audio-ingest job is cancelled when recording/local-processing authorization is already revoked; the worker does not read audio or publish a result.
If authorization is withdrawn during audio processing, the worker checks again before committing the result, cancels the job, and leaves the result and transcript-version table empty.
limitations: Tests seed synthetic authorization rows directly; they do not exercise the authenticated consent API route.
The broad TestClient consent/revocation workflow cannot currently run on this Windows host: a minimal FastAPI TestClient blocks in asyncio Windows Proactor _fallback_socketpair.
